svg.title: K03: It starts. It dies. It starts. It dies.
svg.desc: The Deployment sets PORT to the word eighty. The app turns it into a number at startup, fails, and exits. The kubelet keeps restarting it with a growing wait.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It starts. It dies. It starts. It dies.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A crash loop is a container that exits as fast as it is restarted

svg.text: Each restart waits a little longer (10 s, 20 s, 40 s...). That growing wait is the "BackOff" in the status.
